Former Navy SEAL and podcaster Shawn Ryan joins Tucker Carlson for a rapid-fire briefing on several hot stories. The episode title lists them: President Biden's cancer news, Kash Patel and Dan Bongino speaking on Epstein, and claims of CIA efforts to infiltrate podcasts. Ryan brings an operator's bluntness to each.

Ryan and Carlson trade views on how much of the Epstein story officials still hide. They discuss why intelligence agencies would care about podcast audiences at all. Biden's health and the honesty of his team also get sharp treatment. Watching listeners get a dense hour of claims and counterclaims to sort through.
